text:
nina (AE): Quick sync  customer wants a Hosted POC but with hard requirement: no EU/APAC egress or subprocessors for their tenant. Failover must stay within US regions. Need feasibility + SOW bullets.

cal (SE): Technically doable using tenant routing policies + integration toggles. Main risk: telemetry and model artifact replication. Need ops + infra checks.

ops-lin: We can add a tenant-level geo-denylist and disable non-US integrations. Will run subprocessor inventory to find any non-US-only vendors. Estimate 2 business days for inventory + 2 for canary.

infra-sam: Model store: we normally replicate artifacts. For POC we can pin artifacts to US buckets and block replication per-tenant. That may increase cold-start latency for non-US-origin traffic. Also KMS: need tenant-scoped keys in US and disable auto-replication.

legal-ana: If they require contractual guarantee that no subprocessor outside US will touch data, we need a subprocessor amendment and attestation. That usually adds 7-10 business days. If they accept operational attestation only, it's faster.

nina (AE): Price impact? They want an estimate to include in the SOW.

ops-lin: Rough uplift estimate: 8-14% on unit cost depending on traffic shape since placement is constrained. Recommend a "geo-lock surcharge" line in SOW plus PS days for validation.

cal (SE): Example snippet to show them:

```
tenant: client-zen
routing:
  deny_regions: [europe-west1, asia-east1]
  preferred_regions: [us-east1, us-west1]
geo_controls:
  model_storage: US_ONLY
  telemetry: disabled_for_tenant
kms: tenant_keys: [us-east1:ckey]
```

ops-lin: I'll produce an ops checklist and a short attestation template if legal needs it. Canary branch will be created.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Branch created: refs/sales/geo-lock-2980012345. CI started. :white_check_mark:

nina (AE): Thanks all  I'll update customer with timeline and the config snippet. Tagging @legal-ana for contract bullets.
